items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: But Clark Terry, he never worked under Charlie but Shorty Baker did.

ctx.x: Sure, sure. The same with Clark Terry. Now Clark Terry came up after we left St. Louis but how he admired he told me, I had my Charlie when he was young. That's why Clark Terry's such a good musician in St. Louis. I mean, you know --
Shorty Baker, oh, yeah. But Clark Terry, he never worked under Charlie but Shorty Baker did.
